We need to determine SMILES of unknown organic compound based on data. But we have no data provided in prompt. The "Available input data:" is empty. So we have no spectra. We could perhaps need to request measurements? But we must justify resource use. Since no data, we cannot deduce. Perhaps we need to request mass spectrometry first to get molecular weight, then NMR etc. But we need to be efficient.

We could start by measuring mass spectrometry to get molecular weight and formula. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool. That will give us spectrum string. Then we can infer formula? Could also use get_formula_from_smiles after we guess. But we need to propose SMILES. Without any data, we must gather data.

Thus first step: mass_spectrometry_spectra.
